define_simulation_graph: define a TensorFlow graph for reinforcement learning algorithm and environment interaction with batch environments
define_batch_env: create a batch environment wrapping multiple OpenAI gym environments for parallel agent training
define_saver: create a TensorFlow saver to checkpoint model variables with optional regex exclusion patterns
initialize_variables: initialize or restore TensorFlow variables from a checkpoint file in the specified log directory
save_config: save a reinforcement learning configuration object as a YAML file to the logging directory
